title: Solari Capital Founder Scaramucci: Betting on Bitcoin & Exponential Technology
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Solari Capital Founder Scaramucci: Betting on Bitcoin & Exponential Technology AJ Scaramucci reveals Solari Capital’s $350M launch and breaks down his “programmable reality” thesis across AI, biotech, and Bitcoin debasement.
